test: Visible DW4 Chrome display capture of the BattleShip (Metal) window; host stream tracks inspected and guest page received live video.
guestAudio: Not delivered: the host MediaStream contained no audio track to send.
reason: Chrome getDisplayMedia requested audio/systemAudio, but the tested macOS display/window capture returned video only. A synthetic canvas oscillator is not evidence of BattleShip audio. Installing a virtual audio device is outside the no-install constraint.
exactNoInstallFix: Extend the native ScreenCaptureKit helper to run an SCStream with capturesAudio enabled, 48 kHz stereo PCM, and an audio SCStreamOutput callback.
Forward timestamped PCM only over a loopback IPC channel to the host page; keep sample buffers out of logs and disk.
Feed the PCM into a browser AudioWorklet, render it to a MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode, and add that audio track to each guest RTCPeerConnection alongside the existing video track.
Expose guest mute/unmute, measure A/V offset with a test tone and video timestamp, and verify system audio capture permission on this macOS version.
